explanation: Adds scripts/public-export/ (export.mts, manifest.mjs, overlay/ and its README): a maintainer-only tool that writes the public hypoexplorer repository tree from committed HEAD blobs (overlays included, and only from a committed exporter), applies the reviewed edits and overlays, and refuses to finish on secrets, the owner's writing, personal paths or missing third-party notices. It is run by hand, is excluded from its own export, and changes no application code, registry entry, data product, build or check. Also: The regenerated public/tracker/catalog.js omits survey score rationale and risks, and one survey correction note is reworded to drop a manuscript reference.
